contracts.semantics: SDK owns matching/identity/branches/context/stats. CLI translates arguments into QueryRequest and calls injected QueryApi, then injected QueryWriter. Use the existing core schema/FieldId/Metric registry; never a second schema or source registry.
contracts.routes: All 27 leaves including docs/schema/help/version. Explicit native sessions export, sessions list --root, and native --adapter forms remain native. Query filtering uses --source-adapter. Reject mixed modes, no raw argv/default-adapter routing.
contracts.guidance: Every outcome gives a useful nonempty next action; every error gives concrete safe recovery/alternatives. Render real grammar. Raw JSONL/CSV/text/Markdown/OTLP streams stay free of guidance records; use envelopes or diagnostic channels as designed.
contracts.privacy: Never echo private input in errors/actions. Content predicates authorize inspection only; explicit content output consent remains separate. IsContext is output-only metadata, no --is-context predicate. Statistics-only fields are not row-operation columns/sorts.
contracts.files: Create-new output, staging/publication and truthful partial-write/flush failures. No source-store mutations.
contracts.integration: PM owns app/main.rs, app/adapters.rs, root workspace/lock/architecture and all canonical plan records. Publish exact ParsedCommand/new frontend API to PM early. Remove obsolete requested_session_adapter instead of keeping a shim; PM migrates app callers. Git-ai bridge/native-note-specific app integration remains PM-owned.
